axis_dependent_ui_asymmetries_found.detail: For a Z-pair, A and B never co-appear on the docked XY plane (different z). For Y-pairs they co-appear on XY; for X-pairs they co-appear on XY. Each axis has exactly one docked plane where B is absent, but the commonly attended XY plane systematically hides B only for Z.
Main volume slice is parked on A. Y/X neighbors share A's Z slice; Z neighbor requires changing the Z slider to see B in the main view.
Presentation order is constant. Alone this cannot explain Z-specific DIFFERENT unless combined with an axis-specific visual/semantic cue; recorded here as a residual bias channel.
_plane() normalizes each 2-D view independently; orthogonal planes can look differently contrasted for the same volume.

1_coordinate_pair_bug.basis: Prior geometry tests 4/4 for central +1 neighbor; -008 queues and events match canonical +1 Z/Y/X pairs; writer recomputes right from left+channel; no array transpose in reviewer path

2_presentation_ui_semantic_artifact.basis: Documented XY co-visibility asymmetry and A-only napari focus specifically disadvantage Z-pair joint inspection relative to Y/X, while every completed triplet is Z=DIFFERENT / Y,X=SAME

3_annotation_target_definition_problem.basis: Local SAME/DIFFERENT neuronal-process judgment on a single face may not be axis-comparable even if UI were equalized; the intended affinity relation may be ill-posed as elicited

4_raw_image_membrane_phenomenon.basis: FIB-SEM milling/section direction can imprint membrane appearance along Z without being a voxel-size anisotropy; could produce a real image-domain axis effect distinct from process topology

5_genuine_biological_orientation_effect.basis: Cannot be claimed while presentation asymmetries and target-definition concerns remain open; isotropic 8 nm spacing rules out trivial physical step-size anisotropy only

historical_H3_argmax_gradient_selection.basis: All three axes reviewed at the same physical center under axis-neutral paired-location protocol-004; pattern still 12/12

why_target_marked_invalid: As operationalized and collected under the current reviewer path, labels are a deterministic function of global axis identity (12/12). That violates the intended constraint for an isotropic-volume biological affinity target usable for axis-agnostic membrane learning. Validity as a scientific description of biology is not claimed; validity as a training target is denied.
